g.text: the content policy is written first; the layers enforce it
1 model training: refuse or safely complete risky requests
2 input filters: classify prompts by policy category
3 output filters: check responses before display
4 product design: limit tools, rate limits, account signals
5 human review and escalation: borderline, high severity
both need controls; the controls differ
red-team before launch and on a schedule; turn findings into tests
tiered replies: crisis resources for self-harm; decline and offer an alternative
a policy with examples of allowed and disallowed requests
